newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Cementos del Caribe's Q1 net off sharply.
newsitem.headline: Cementos del Caribe's Q1 net off sharply.

text.p: The first quarter net profit of Colombia's Cementos del Caribe fell 42 percent from the same period last year, from 13.95 billion pesos to 8.07 billion, the Securities Superintendency said.
It said the company's operating income rose slightly, however, from 17.30 billion pesos a year ago to 17.37 billion in the first quarter of 1997.
Net assets rose considerably, meanwhile, from 713.2 billion pesos a year ago to 8.07 billion in the first quarter of 1997.
The Securities Superintendency gave no specific reason for the sharp drop in net profit at the firm, whose leading shareholders belong to the highly diversified Sindicato Antioqueno group.
